description: We are a passionate and enthusiastic team of BTech students interested in technology, innovation, and problem-solving. We enjoy learning new skills, sharing ideas, and working together to develop creative solutions. We are looking for dedicated team members with skills in programming, communication, creativity, teamwork, and problem-solving who are eager to learn and contribute.
